changelog: Kill Switch now detects a crashed tunnel and blocks traffic instead of silently falling back to a direct, unprotected connection
Fixed manual "Check for Updates" showing a fake update when you were already on the latest version
Server sharing and importing now use real, scannable QR codes instead of a placeholder icon
Fixed pasted custom JSON configs showing a placeholder server address instead of the real one
UI and theme refinements across Settings, Update, and the connection screen
